correctness.rationale: For H_n (n>=3), a_i b_j adjacent iff i<=j. Nested neighborhoods mean two noncodewords in one shore have comparable identifying sets, which contradicts solidness; at most one omission per shore and hence |C|>=2n-2. Each mixed omitted pair is solid except (a_1,b_1) and (a_n,b_n), where a leaf is undominated: exactly n²-2 minimum DLD codes. A standard SLD forced-codeword criterion N(u)⊆N[v] forces a_i (i>=2) and b_j (j<=n-1), so the sole optimum omission is {a_1,b_n}; literal closed-neighborhood intersection verifies it for n>=3. n=2 SLD instead 3. Independently checked all minimum families n=2..7 by the original definitions.
